question: A $p\text{-}n$ junction diode is connected first in forward bias and then in reverse bias. Compare the depletion layer width and current in both cases. Give reason.

options.A:
Forward bias
The depletion layer widens and current becomes nearly zero.
Reverse bias
The depletion layer narrows and a large majority current flows.
options.B:
Forward bias
The barrier potential decreases, depletion layer narrows and a large majority-carrier current flows.
Reverse bias
The barrier potential increases, depletion layer widens and only a small minority-carrier current flows.
options.C:
Forward bias
Both barrier potential and current remain unchanged.
Reverse bias
All carriers disappear from the junction.
options.D:
Forward bias
The barrier increases and the diode blocks current.
Reverse bias
The barrier decreases and current is maximum.
